lore.title: Theo Locked Everyone Out of the Bnb
lore.story: Late on the first night of the lake trip Theo locked the door 'for safety' while everyone was at the dock. The door code was in his email, and his phone was charging inside, so they waited on the porch until the host called back after midnight.

lore.title: Marcus Fell Off the Easiest Wall at the Gym
lore.story: Two days after saying climbing 'can't be that hard', Marcus fell off the beginner wall at the second hold while kids climbed it, and one of them asked if he was ok.

lore.title: Nikhil's 4am Demo Somehow Won
lore.story: At 1:30am Nikhil pivoted the hackathon project; at 4am he recorded the demo, said 'and it works' and it worked two seconds later. The judges laughed at the pause and the team won.
